name: Pearling, Testimony of an Island Economy
description: This trail winds through the old town of Muharraq in Bahrain, linking 17 historic buildings, including merchants' mansions, shops, storehouses and a mosque, along a 3.5 km walking route. It continues to the Bu Mahir fortress on the island's southern tip, where pearl-diving boats once departed for three offshore oyster beds. Together they preserve the memory of the trade that powered the Gulf until the 1930s.
